items.title: Hook, hold, harvest and hide: Meta's alleged strategy laid out in first week
items.title_zh: 钩住、留住、收割、隐藏：Meta 被指的策略在庭审首周曝光
items.summary: In a trial that opened on Tuesday, California and 28 other states accused Meta of designing addictive sites and violating laws protecting children's privacy, The Guardian reports.

items.title: ElevenLabs, TwelveLabs, ThirteenLabs
items.title_zh: ElevenLabs、TwelveLabs、ThirteenLabs
items.summary: A blog post catalogs companies named after a number plus “labs”, from ElevenLabs through FourteenLabs and beyond, after the author googled “thirteenlabs” and found an AI project for 3D scenery. The page lists numbers 0–99 with links and marks which companies are AI-related.

items.title: There's no reason for software to be slow anymore
items.title_zh: 软件没理由再这么慢了
items.summary: Dan Luu argues that the cost of formerly specialized performance work has fallen by orders of magnitude, so optimizations that once paid off only at large scale are now broadly worthwhile. The post opens with a viral tweet claiming that LLMs produce slow, bloated code.

items.title: Munder Difflin – Agent harness to run an office of your clones
items.title_zh: Munder Difflin：让你的克隆体开一间办公室的 Agent harness
items.summary: Munder Difflin is a free and open-source multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and nine more terminal agents as an office of clones on your own machine, using subscriptions you already pay for. It now includes the Stapler for local dictation and meeting notes.

items.title: Anthropic appears to be A/B testing reduced effort levels in Claude Code
items.title_zh: Anthropic 疑似在 Claude Code 中 A/B 测试更低的 effort 档位
items.summary: A post on X says Anthropic appears to be A/B testing reduced effort levels in Claude Code.

items.title: NanoGPT Speedrun Frontier
items.title_zh: NanoGPT Speedrun 前沿榜
items.summary: Prime Intellect compares 153 autonomous runs from 18 frontier models on the nanoGPT optimizer speedrun.

items.title: Initial focus for our partnership with Motorola is a regular non-folding device
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS：与 Motorola 合作的首要目标是一款非折叠设备
items.summary: GrapheneOS says its partnership with Motorola will initially focus on a regular non-folding device. It notes that the current Motorola Signature, Razr Fold and Razr Ultra (all 2026) are close to meeting its requirements but lack MTE, adequate secure element integration and other features being added for 2027.

items.title: Stalking the Wily Hacker: 40 years later – Cliff Stoll [video]
items.title_zh: 追踪狡猾的黑客：40 年后——Cliff Stoll（视频）
items.summary: Cliff Stoll recalls tripping over a 75-cent accounting glitch in a Unix system 40 years ago, a clue that led to a year-long chase across networks and modem banks.

items.title: Canada will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
items.title_zh: 贸易谈判破裂，加拿大将“逐美元”对等回应美国关税
items.summary: Canada will match US tariffs dollar for dollar after trade talks broke down, according to a BBC report.

items.title: Z80 – The 1970s Microprocessor Still Alive (2021)
items.title_zh: Z80——仍然存活的 1970 年代微处理器（2021）
items.summary: A 2021 IEEE Micro article revisits the Z80 microprocessor from the 1970s, which the piece describes as still alive.

items.summary: In a trial that opened on Tuesday, California and 28 other states accused Meta of designing addictive sites and violating laws protecting children's privacy, The Guardian reports.

items.title: A Kantian Critique of "Sorry" by Justin Bieber
items.title_zh: 对 Justin Bieber《Sorry》的康德式批判
items.summary: A blog post examines Justin Bieber's “Sorry” through a Kantian lens, asking what makes an apology morally meaningful.

items.title: New MCP Roadmap
items.title_zh: 新版 MCP 路线图
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol project published an update on its roadmap and the focus areas for upcoming specification releases.

items.title: Nostr is an inclusive communication commons
items.title_zh: Nostr 是包容性的通信公地
items.summary: Nostr is presented as a simple standard defining a scalable architecture of clients and servers that lets information spread freely without control by any corporation or government. It is described as embracing the chaos of the early internet, with multiple kinds of data and clients offering their own perspectives on the same underlying information.

items.title: Belgian car salesman becomes prince after DNA test proves royal parentage
items.title_zh: 比利时汽车销售员因 DNA 检测证实王室血统成为王子
items.summary: A 26-year-old car salesman has formally become a prince after being acknowledged as the son of Prince Laurent, the brother of Belgium's king, CNN reports.

items.title: Scrap (2006)
items.title_zh: Scrap（2006）
items.summary: A Hacker News submission points to a 2006 item titled “Scrap” through a link to Moxie Marlinspike's X account; no further description is provided.

items.title: Thinking in Python
items.title_zh: 用 Python 思考
items.summary: Bruce Eckel's book “Thinking in Python” is freely readable online under a CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 license, with optional support through GitHub Sponsors or Ko-fi. Commercial publication requires a contract with the author.

items.title: FireRedTeam/FireRedAudio
items.title_zh: FireRedTeam/FireRedAudio（Python）
items.summary: FireRedAudio is a Python repository from the FireRedTeam organization that is trending on GitHub; the listing provides no further description.

items.title: bojieli/ai-infra-book
items.title_zh: bojieli/ai-infra-book：开源 AI Infra 书稿
items.summary: An open-source book manuscript, “Understanding AI Infra: Quantitative Analysis and System Design”, derives LLM inference and training system designs from hardware constraints and model architectures. The repository includes the full text, a PDF, companion calculation tools and experiments.

items.title: totec448-spec/chat-on-steroids
items.title_zh: totec448-spec/chat-on-steroids
items.summary: The project provides cross-platform local MCP capabilities for ChatGPT, with Chrome integration, Goal, Compact and Resume features, and durable multi-agent workflows. It is written in TypeScript.

items.title: nateherkai/scroll-craft
items.title_zh: nateherkai/scroll-craft：滚动叙事网站构建技能
items.summary: Scroll Craft is an agent skill for building premium, immersive, scroll-driven websites that works with Codex, Claude Code and other coding agents. It is also available as a Claude Code plugin and is written in JavaScript.

items.title: Vincentwei1021/video-talkcraft
items.title_zh: Vincentwei1021/video-talkcraft：口播讲解视频生成技能
items.summary: Video Talkcraft is an agent skill that turns Claude Code or Codex into a motion-design studio for voiceover-driven explainer videos. It offers word-level voiceover sync, 109 motion recipe cards, an anti-slideshow camera system and Remotion rendering.

items.title: ApodexAI/FrontierAgent
items.title_zh: ApodexAI/FrontierAgent：开源 Agent 框架
items.summary: ApodexAI open-sourced FrontierAgent, an agent framework with a native command-line TUI and ReAct and Agent Team modes. It runs with one command on macOS and Linux, requires no preinstall and has no hard Docker dependency.

items.title: vladelaina/BongoCat
items.title_zh: vladelaina/BongoCat
items.summary: BongoCat is a C project that combines SDL3 and OpenGL, described by its author as three mysterious forces united as one. The repository links to a Discord community.

items.title: duty1g/x64dbg-mcp-server
items.title_zh: duty1g/x64dbg-mcp-server：x64dbg 的 MCP 插件
items.summary: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's functionality over HTTP, letting MCP-compatible AI assistants set breakpoints, step through code, read memory and dump registers. It is built with Zig as a zero-dependency, single-binary, cross-platform tool.

items.title: Development and Feasibility Evaluation of an Edge AI as Medical Device System for Breast Cancer Multidisciplinary Team Meetings
items.title_zh: 面向乳腺癌多学科团队会议的边缘 AI 医疗器械系统开发与可行性评估
items.summary: The authors developed a fully on-device pipeline using open-source ASR and LLMs on a single NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin to transcribe breast cancer MDT discussions, structure clinical information, and generate NICE-grounded treatment recommendations via RAG. Evaluation on recorded and synthetic discussions found reduced ASR word error rates and more MDT-concordant interventions than a proprietary cloud comparator, supporting the feasibility of privacy-preserving on-device decision support.

items.title: TANGO: Treating Tokens as Operators
items.title_zh: TANGO：将 token 视为算子
items.summary: TANGO computes a nonlinear feature-wise gate at each source token, averages these gates per destination, and uses the average to modulate a linear projection of the destination, forming the diagonal core of a source-conditioned linear operator. At matched parameters and training data, full-prefix TANGO has the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood in all 16 settings, and a narrower three-set variant reaches 3.26 to 3.45 times its throughput.

items.title: How Weight Encoding Affects Language Model Placement and Performance on the Apple Neural Engine
items.title_zh: 权重编码如何影响语言模型在 Apple Neural Engine 上的部署与性能
items.summary: Using the public Core ML deployment path, the study combines compiler device plans, synchronized memory-controller measurements, and compute-unit exclusion controls to examine how dense fp16, int8, and ternary weight encodings affect where language-model checkpoints execute. It finds encoding-dependent placement, with a smaller fp16 export running on the CPU while compressed counterparts show ANE activity, and reports a 1.9x reduction in warm forward latency for the int8 export.

items.title: CST: Collaborative Selective Transmission for Communication-Efficient Multimodal Edge Inference
items.title_zh: CST：面向通信高效多模态边缘推理的协同选择性传输
items.summary: Collaborative Selective Transmission is a main-directed query-response framework that retrieves only helper information complementary to the main device's current representation, sending sparse support indices instead of dense helper features. Across three multimodal sensing benchmarks it transmits at most 14.18% of helper feature values and achieves up to 4.27x end-to-end speedup over Transmit-All on a five-node NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano testbed.

items.title: Decoupled Physical Modeling and Execution for Physics Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向物理推理的解耦式物理建模与执行
items.summary: The paper introduces a framework that distills intermediate representations explicitly encoding the physical modeling process and uses two-stage post-training, with supervised fine-tuning for structured modeling followed by rubric-based reinforcement learning to improve modeling quality. Across PhysReason, PhyX, and SeePhys, physical modeling outperforms GRPO by about 3% on average for small vision-language models.

items.title: Task-Driven 3D Printability Assistance via Geometry- and Knowledge-Grounded LLM Reasoning
items.title_zh: 任务驱动的 3D 打印可行性辅助：以几何与知识为依据的 LLM 推理
items.summary: The framework grounds LLM reasoning in STL geometry evidence and structured material and printer knowledge to produce pre-print recommendations covering printability, material choice, process parameters, design guidance, risks, and explanations for a natural-language task description. It achieved 75.0% printability over 96 physical validation trials and raised Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite material-selection accuracy from 37.5% to 90.0%.
